nights.title: Karsu
nights.name: Karsu
nights.extract: Karsu Dönmez, known mononymously as Karsu, is a Turkish-Dutch singer, pianist and composer. While her music style is a blend of various genres, jazz pop is probably the best description for it. She has songs in Dutch, English, and Turkish.

nights.title: Bülent Ersoy
nights.name: Bülent Ersoy
nights.extract: Bülent Ersoy is a Turkish singer, actress, and media personality. She is known as one of the most popular singers of Turkish music. Ersoy has many famous hits such as "Ümit Hırsızı" (Hope Thief), "Geceler" (Nights), "Beddua" (Curse), "Maazallah" (God Forbid), "Biz Ayrılamayız" (We Cannot Break Up), and "Sefam Olsun" (I Enjoy Myself). Ersoy has published more than thirty albums so far and has made a name for herself in Turkish music history. She remains an icon of the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey.

sie bleibt eine ikone der LGBTQ+-gemeinschaft in der Türkei.

tr.kicker: Türk şarkıcı, oyuncu ve medya kişiliği
tr.who: Bülent Ersoy bir Türk şarkıcı, oyuncu ve medya kişiliğidir. Ersoy, Türk müziğinin en popüler şarkıcılarından biri olarak tanınır.
facts: Ersoy şimdiye kadar otuzdan fazla albüm yayımlamış ve Türk müziği tarihinde kendine bir isim yapmıştır.
Türkiye'de LGBTQ+ topluluğunun bir simgesi olmaya devam etmektedir.
